exposure: universal ultrasound scanning for breech presentation at 36 weeks gestation
ultrasound screening for breech presentation near term (36 weeks of gestational age [wkGA]) in nulliparous women
finding: Universal late pregnancy ultrasound in nulliparous women would virtually eliminate undiagnosed breech presentation, would be expected to reduce foetal mortality in breech presentation, and would be cost effective if foetal presentation could be assessed for less than £19.80 per woman.
mod_finding: Universal late-pregnancy ultrasound would reduce emergency cesarean sections and vaginal breech deliveries.
